r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='python3 << 'PYEOF'
import arrow
# Check various date ranges
test_cases = [
    ((2023, 1, 1), (2023, 2, 1)),  # 1 month
    ((2023, 1, 1), (2023, 3, 1)),  # 2 months
    ((2023, 1, 1), (2023, 4, 1)),  # 3 months
    ((2023, 1, 1), (2023, 5, 1)),  # 4 months
    ((2023, 2, 1), (2023, 4, 1)),  # 2 months (DST)
    ((2023, 1, 1), (2023, 1, 15)), # half month
]
for start, end in test_cases:
    arw1 = arrow.get(*start)
    arw2 = arrow.get(*end)
    delta_s = abs((arw2._datetime - arw1._datetime).total_seconds())
    result = arw1.humanize(arw2)
    cal_months = (end[0]*12 + end[1]) - (start[0]*12 + start[1])
    print(f"{start} -> {end}: cal_months={cal_months}, secs={delta_s:.0f}, result={repr(result)}")
PYEOF')
print(r['content'])
